featured_reviews.name: SAHIL RATNAPARKHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience with Tirth Accessories for my XSR 155 accessories setup.

A special thanks to Karan, who was extremely polite, friendly, and helpful throughout the entire process. Even before visiting the store, he patiently answered all my questions and queries over call and guided me properly.

When I went for the installation, he honestly suggested which accessories were actually essential for my bike right now and which ones I could skip for the time being instead of unnecessarily pushing products. That honesty and guidance genuinely stood out.

All the parts and accessories installed were from trusted and genuine brands like Motor Torque, HT Exhaust, and Moto Care. The installation and service were quick, clean, and most importantly very cost-effective.

Thank you Karan and Tirth Accessories for helping me make my XSR 155 truly look like a head-turner on the road and something one of a kind. Really happy with the overall experience! 🙌🏍️

featured_reviews.name: nidhi parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really impressed with the accessories fitted on my bike — the quality and finishing were excellent and have completely transformed the look of the vehicle. Everything was installed neatly and in a professional manner.

I also had a very good overall servicing experience. The bike now feels much smoother after the service, and all the work was completed on time. Special thanks to Karan, who was extremely helpful and guided me properly throughout the process. Pricing was reasonable, and the customer service was excellent. Highly recommended for both bike accessories and servicing.

Additionally, the Simtac Navigation Screen M3T that I got from here is truly amazing. The display quality, responsiveness, and overall performance are impressive, and it has significantly enhanced my riding experience.
